SELECT Employees.employee_name, COUNT(DISTINCT Circulation_History.document_id) AS drafts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT Draft_Copies.document_id) AS copies_count
FROM Employees
JOIN Circulation_History ON Employees.employee_id = Circulation_History.employee_id
GROUP BY Employees.employee_id
ORDER BY drafts_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT e.employee_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dh.draft_number) AS drafts, COUNT(DISTINCT dc.copy_number) AS copies
FROM Employees e
JOIN Circulation_History dh ON e.employee_id = dh.employee_id
JOIN Draft_Copies dc ON dh.document_id = dc.document_id
GROUP BY e.employee_id
ORDER BY copies DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT e.employee_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.document_id) as num_drafts, COUNT(DISTINCT dc.copy_number) as num_copies
FROM Employees e
JOIN Circulation_History ch ON e.employee_id = ch.employee_id
JOIN Documents d ON ch.document_id = d.document_id
JOIN Draft_Copies dc ON d.document_id = dc.document_id
GROUP BY e.employee_id
ORDER BY num_drafts, num_copies DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT e.employee_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dh.draft_number) as drafts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT dc.copy_number) as copies_count FROM Employees e JOIN Circulation_History dh ON e.employee_id = dh.employee_id JOIN Draft_Copies dc ON dh.document_id = dc.document_id GROUP BY e.employee_id ORDER BY drafts_count DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT e.employee_name, COUNT(dc.document_id) AS drafts_count, COUNT(dc.copy_number) AS copies_count
FROM Employees e
JOIN Circulation_History ch ON e.employee_id = ch.employee_id
JOIN Draft_Copies dc ON ch.document_id = dc.document_id
GROUP BY e.employee_id
ORDER BY drafts_count + copies_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT Employees.employee_name, COUNT(DISTINCT Circulation_History.document_id) AS drafts_and_copies FROM Employees JOIN Circulation_History ON Employees.employee_id = Circulation_History.employee_id GROUP BY Employees.employee_id ORDER BY drafts_and_copies DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT e.employee_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.draft_number) AS drafts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT dc.copy_number) AS copies_count
FROM Employees e
JOIN Circulation_History ch ON e.employee_id = ch.employee_id
JOIN Document_Drafts cd ON ch.document_id = cd.document_id
JOIN Draft_Copies dc ON cd.draft_number = dc.draft_number
GROUP BY e.employee_id
ORDER BY drafts_count DESC, copies_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT e.employee_name, COUNT(cdocument_id) AS drafts_count, COUNT(dcopy_id) AS copies_count FROM Employees e JOIN Circulation_History ch ON e.employee_id = ch.employee_id JOIN Draft_Copies dc ON ch.document_id = dc.document_id JOIN Documents_Mailed dm ON dc.document_id = dm.document_id GROUP BY e.employee_id ORDER BY drafts_count DESC LIMIT 1
